questions.stem: In a forensic medicine case review session, a PG resident is discussing the techniques used for age determination in cases involving unidentified remains. A key focus is on the role of ossification centers in estimating developmental stages, particularly in fetal and infant remains. The PG presents a scenario where the remains of a fetus was found, and the determination of the developmental stage is crucial for the ongoing investigation. Based on the standard timeline for the appearance of ossification centers, at what stage of development do the earliest centers of ossification typically appear?
